description: This Java class, ContentTypeValidationDirective, provides functionality to validate the Content-Type header of HTTP requests within an Akka HTTP server context. Its main purpose is to ensure that incoming requests have a supported media type, and if not, it throws an UnsupportedMediaTypeException. It extracts media types from request headers or defaults, logs relevant information, and wraps route handling logic.

classes.name: ContentTypeValidationDirective
classes.description: A utility class that provides a static method to ensure the Content-Type of incoming HTTP requests is supported, throwing exceptions and logging as necessary.

methods.name: ensureValidContentType
methods.description: Checks if the request's media type is within the set of supported types; proceeds with the route if valid, otherwise throws an exception.

methods.name: extractMediaType
methods.description: Extracts the media type string from the HttpRequest, prioritizing headers but falling back to the request entity content type if needed.

methods.name: requestToLogString
methods.description: Creates a loggable string representation of the HttpRequest including host, method, and path.
